title: FindMySpot lot layout
description: Static geometry of a monitored zone, fetched once at load from GET /api/layout. Does not change while the camera is fixed, so it is never sent on the WebSocket.

lot_name.description: Human readable name for the header.

entrance.description: Where cars enter, in normalized top-down coordinates. Route animations start here.

spots.description: Keyed by spot id, matching the keys in state.schema.json.

polygon.description: Corners in normalized top-down coordinates, clockwise. Render these directly as an SVG polygon.

centroid.description: Polygon centre, for labels and as the route endpoint.

distance_to_entrance_m.description: Approximate walking distance in metres. Drives best_spot selection.

aisles.description: Waypoint graph used to route a driver from the entrance to a chosen spot.

nodes.description: Keyed by node id, value is [x, y] in normalized top-down coordinates.
